rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for doing something with intense effort, energy, or urgency.

example.english: They studied feverishly and finally came first in the exam.
example.traditional: 佢拼命咁溫書，終於考第一。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ping3 ming6 gam3 wan1 syu1 zung1 jyu1 haau2 dai6 jat1

rows.note: Choose this when the key idea is doing something very rapidly rather than enthusiastically.

example.english: The machine feverishly printed all the documents.
example.traditional: 部機飛快咁印晒啲文件。
example.jyutping: bou6 gei1 fei1 faai3 gam3 jan3 saai3 di1 man4 gin2

rows.note: Choose this when the feverish manner specifically highlights excitement or eager enthusiasm.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hing1 fan5 gam3 caak3 fan6 lai5 mat6

rows.note: Choose this when the emphasis is on putting in great effort and energy.

example.english: They pedaled feverishly and finally caught up with the bus.
example.traditional: 佢落力咁踩單車，終於追到班車。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lok6 lik6 gam3 caai2 daan1 ce1 zung1 jyu1 zeoi1 dou2 baan1 ce1
